# Welcome to Modified Vanilla Pack!

This pack is improved with [Optimized Fabric](https://modrinth.com/modpack/optimized-fabric) and updated with new built-in mods and settings.

The assembly is designed **for all computers**, weak and powerful. You can comfortably **play without lags and freezes**. At the same time, you can add your own mods to this assembly. **Enjoy high fps and chill mods!**

Supported Versions -

1.16.5 - 1.21.10

**Good Luck!**
